Class DecodeCudaGraph

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.engine.DecodeCudaGraph
public final class DecodeCudaGraph extends Object
Phase 2c: optional CUDA graph capture for batch-1 decode forward.

Unlike SMILE_FLASHINFER_DECODE_CUDA_GRAPH (reverted — FlashInfer plan flag only), this captures the full decode forward via at::cuda::CUDAGraph.

Enable with environment variable SMILE_DECODE_CUDA_GRAPH=1.

Phase 2d (multi-batch): graphs are bucketed by (batch, numPages) for uniform decode steps: batch must be a power of two in [1, maxBatch], and every row must share the same KV cache length. RoPE, token, logits, and KV index buffers are sized to the live batch.
